findings.title: Mixed event batches could exceed the API's total count cap and be discarded
findings.impact: Optional usage counts were lost during a burst involving more than one event name. Local case functionality and privacy isolation were unaffected.

reproduction.environment: Node with mocked localStorage, timers and fetch; local app.fetch only, no D1 binding
steps: Call track('clock_lock_copied') twenty times, then track('escalation_copied') once before the fifteen-second flush.
Flush the captured timer and pass the generated body to the local Worker.
reproduction.expected: At most twenty total positive counts, accepted as a valid batch.

fix.description: Cap the sum across event names before enqueueing; discard excess actions without storing or replaying them.
tests: mixed-event bursts send at most twenty total positive counts, preserving the accepted batch
overflow is dropped without delayed replay or contaminating the next opted-in batch
revoking consent discards a full batch and its overflow before any network request
fix.validation: All 8 new and existing analytics tests passed; TypeScript no-emit check passed.

findings.title: User-facing report retention wording promises a stricter physical deadline than daily cleanup
findings.impact: The privacy notice says 'up to 365 days' and 'expire after one year', while healthy daily cleanup can retain a raw report until almost day 366. Failed cleanup can extend physical retention. Operations documentation already acknowledges scheduled retention. This is a wording/implementation mismatch, not a legal compliance conclusion.

reproduction.environment: In-memory SQLite comparison using the exact retention predicate
reproduction.explanation: The report reaches its 365-day age just after the first daily invocation and remains until the next one.

findings.recommendation: Describe the scheduled 365-day target, daily cleanup delay and failure boundary on the privacy page; remove the unconditional expiry sentence. Keep docs/privacy-operations.md's table consistent.

en.privacy.reports: Optional patient reports: insurer, TPA, optional city, request type, submission/decision times and outcome are stored in Cloudflare D1 for grouped waiting-time research. Daily cleanup removes reports older than 365 days; removal may take up to another day, or longer if cleanup fails. No hospital name, patient name, policy number, document, IP or user-agent is stored by the app.
en.privacy.publicationBody: We publish only groups with at least ten reports. Exact timestamps, individual cities and hospital names are not published. Closed monthly groups reduce the chance of identification. Erasing a report withdraws the affected public group too. Raw reports are removed by the scheduled cleanup described above.
en.optin.body: Optional: share insurer, TPA, city (if provided), request type, submission/decision times and outcome. City is optional. No name, hospital, documents or claim number. Reports are scheduled for removal after one year; see Privacy & data for cleanup timing. Public cells need at least 10 reports. Keep your deletion code to withdraw.

hi.privacy.reports: वैकल्पिक मरीज़ रिपोर्ट: समूहों में इंतज़ार के आँकड़ों पर शोध के लिए बीमा कंपनी, TPA, वैकल्पिक शहर, अनुरोध का प्रकार, अनुरोध/निर्णय समय और परिणाम Cloudflare D1 में रखे जाते हैं। रोज़ की सफ़ाई 365 दिन से पुरानी रिपोर्ट हटाती है; इसमें एक अतिरिक्त दिन लग सकता है, और सफ़ाई विफल होने पर अधिक देर भी हो सकती है। ऐप अस्पताल या मरीज़ का नाम, पॉलिसी संख्या, दस्तावेज़, IP या यूज़र-एजेंट नहीं रखता।
hi.privacy.publicationBody: कम से कम दस रिपोर्ट वाले समूह ही प्रकाशित होते हैं। सटीक समय, व्यक्तिगत शहर और अस्पताल के नाम नहीं दिखते। पूरे हो चुके महीनों के समूह पहचान का जोखिम घटाते हैं। रिपोर्ट हटाने पर संबंधित सार्वजनिक समूह भी हटता है। मूल रिपोर्ट ऊपर बताई गई तय सफ़ाई के दौरान हटाई जाती हैं।
hi.optin.body: वैकल्पिक: बीमा कंपनी, TPA, शहर (अगर भरा है), अनुरोध का प्रकार, भेजने और निर्णय के समय तथा परिणाम साझा करें। शहर भरना ज़रूरी नहीं है। नाम, अस्पताल, दस्तावेज़ या दावा संख्या नहीं। रिपोर्ट एक साल बाद तय सफ़ाई में हटाई जाती है; समय की जानकारी गोपनीयता और डेटा पेज पर देखें। सार्वजनिक आँकड़े के लिए कम से कम 10 रिपोर्ट चाहिए। हटाने के लिए कोड रखें।

boundaries: No production database mutation, secret-file read, credentials access, build, commit or deployment was performed by this review.
Only read-only public GETs were made. GET /api/aggregates was deliberately not used because it consumes a D1 quota permit.
Existing production browser/Turnstile round-trip evidence is owned by the main agent; this review's fresh verification-provider tests were mocks.
No exhaustive fresh PDF retranscription or live retry of all insurer sources was performed.
Review results are bounded evidence, not a penetration-test, legal-compliance or anonymity certification.
The main agent is concurrently reviewing UI and running the public browser regression; those results are separate.
